propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria and routing through multiple seams, allowing project disables to be ignored and activated project DET criteria to disappear
A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must be created and compiled once from repository root and operation inputs, then passed to consumers who do not reread ambient policy
Project code-review LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of globs with ["**"] representing repository-wide unconditional selection, replacing the prior empty-list ungating
The stricter non-empty-glob rule applies only to code_review project-prefixed LLM criteria at snapshot-compile time, leaving shared _validate_applies_to and plan-review criteria unchanged
CriteriaSnapshot reuses the existing _overlay_signature content digest rather than inventing a parallel digest mechanism

Golden contract tests must prove snapshot behavior matches current behavior when no overlay is present and verify the approved corrections for effective disables, project DET inclusion, and empty changed_files edge cases
